data_notes: No persistence changes. This feature deduplicates the UTC accrual date helpers (startOfUtcDay, addMonths, periodContaining) by deleting private copies in leave.service.ts and balance.service.ts and importing the canonical implementations from src/shared/date. It is a pure move with no new tables, no schema changes, no repository additions, and no writes. The existing tables (leave_requests, leave_balances, etc.) and repositories (PgLeaveRequestRepository, PgLeaveBalanceRepository, etc.) are untouched and remain as already specified in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. The date helpers are pure functions with no persistence; the load-bearing UTC parsing contract (node-pg DATE columns parsed to UTC via src/shared/db/connection.ts) is unchanged.
transaction_contract: EMPTY — this feature is a pure refactor with no writes; no transaction or unit-of-work contract is required.
